'''Snur''' was a [[gender|male]] [[human]] member of the [[Maya Pei Brigade]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. They were part of a group that were stranded on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]] in [[4 BBY]] following an attack on the brigade. 

==Biography==
By [[4 BBY]], Snur had joined the [[Maya Pei Brigade]] to fight against the [[Galactic Empire]]. In 4 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]], the brigade was attacked and Snur was part of a group of at least sixteen members of the brigade that escaped aboard a [[starship]] that landed on [[Yavin 4]]. However [[Bardi's brother|one member]] of the group subsequently departed in the ship leaving Snur and the rest of the group stranded on the [[moon]]. The group later encountered and [[death|killed]] an individual named [[Porko]] that they found near a clearing with a damaged [[Breon HOY-39 Dayvan]].<ref name="One Year Later" />

[[File:Snur-OneYearLater.jpg|thumb|200px|left|Snur was stranded on Yavin 4 along with several members of the Maya Pei Brigade.]]
Two [[Standard day|days]] after being stranded on the moon, Porko's companion, a man named [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], landed near the HOY-39 in a [[Theft of the TIE Avenger prototype|stolen]] [[TIE Avenger prototype|TIE Avenger]]. As Andor approached the HOY-39 calling out for Porko the brigade members revealed their presence and took Andor prisoner. Snur watched Andor as two members of the group, [[Gerdis]] and [[Bardi]], took turns trying to interrogate Andor. The interrogation was interrupted when [[Rika]], a member of the group, found the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[pilot]] [[helmet]] in the TIE and proclaimed that Andor was an Imperial test pilot. Later on Snur waited outside the TIE while Rika tried to learn to fly the TIE. However after realizing it was a lot more complicated to fly the group discussed the situation with Bardi suggesting that they could threaten to kill Andor. The meeting was interrupted when Andor learned the group was with the Maya Pei Brigade from his guard, [[Crab (individual)|Crab]], with Andor trying but failing to convince the group to trust him. Later on Snur along with [[Nazy]] and [[Neek]] were tasked with guarding Andor while Rika once again tried to learn to pilot the TIE. When Andor began a conversation with Snur about gathering food and water from the [[jungle]], Nazy interrupted telling Snur not to talk to Andor, to which Snur responded that they don't take orders from Bardi. After Rika presses a button in the TIE its [[laser cannon]]s began to fire into the jungle causing the Snur and their fellow guards to dive for cover.<ref name="One Year Later" /> 

That night, an argument between the group erupted when discussing who should be in charge, ultimately coming to a head when Crab shot Rika with his blaster and with [[Rowd]] responding by shooting Crab. The brigade members exchange fire while splitting into two factions; with Snur siding with Gerdis, [[Snee]], [[Bayso]], [[Plug]] and [[Flek]] and regrouping with at the HOY-39 with Andor while the other group retreats to the TIE.<ref name="One Year Later" /> Later that night, Snur stayed with the group in the crashed HOY-39 while Snee crawled through the rain looking for Crab. When she found a dismembered portion of Crab's leg she rain back to the group and informed the group. The following morning the group went through their supplies noting that they had fourteen [[snak-pod]]s and nine [[meal bar]]s but two of them were moldy. Snur stated if they get hungry enough they would eat the moldy ones. The group later sent Plug to sneak over and find out what the other group was doing at the TIE. While waiting for Plug to return, Snur ate their whole meal bar. He returned to the group to inform them that they were trying to rotate the TIE so so that its weapons would point towards Snur's group. Figuring out they could turn the TIE towards them, the group quickly opened fire at the TIE with their [[blaster]]s thus forcing the TIE group to suspend their effort.<ref name="Sagrona Teema">{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}}</ref>

That night Gerdis decided to issue a challenge to Bardi to settle the dispute. Snur joined four other members their group to meet with five members of the other group. When the two groups meet in the middle they all dropped their weapons in unison. Snur watched as the two leaders than began a game of [[Five Hands]] with [[Roski rules]] to decide leadership. However Andor took the distraction of the game as an opportunity to escape his imprisonment and make it to the TIE. However before Andor could get TIE, a [[Yavinian doodar]] came out of the jungle and scooped Bardi and Gerdis in it's mouth. The rest of the group, including Snur scrambled for their guns and began to shoot wildly into the jungle. When the group realized that Andor had made it to the TIE and was taking off they began shooting at it but were unable to stop the TIE from leaving.<ref name="Sagrona Teema" />

==Personality and traits==
Snur had dark skin, [[color|brown]] [[eye]]s and black [[hair]].<ref name="One Year Later" />

==Equipment==
While stranded on Yavin 4, Snur wore a long green [[jacket]] with matching green [[clothing|pants]], a brown [[belt]], black finger-less [[glove]]s and a red [[scarf]].<ref name="One Year Later" />

==Behind the scenes==
Snur was portrayed by [[Chicho Tche]] in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', appearing in the series's first and second episodes, "[[One Year Later]]" and "[[Sagrona Teema]]," which were both released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="One Year Later" /> on [[April 22]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
